info.title: Razorpay API
info.description: Razorpay payment gateway APIs for accepting payments, managing orders, processing refunds, payouts, and subscriptions. All amounts are in the smallest currency sub-unit (e.g. paise for INR). Supports 180+ payment methods including UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets, and EMI.

test.description: Test mode — keys prefixed rzp_test_. Same API endpoint (https://api.razorpay.com/v1). No real money movement. Use test card numbers from https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payments/test-card-details/.

live.description: Live mode — keys prefixed rzp_live_. Real money movement. Requires KYC and business activation on the Razorpay Dashboard.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication using your Razorpay API key pair. Use key_id as the username and key_secret as the password. Encode as Base64(key_id:key_secret). Keys are environment-scoped (Test vs Live). Obtain keys at https://dashboard.razorpay.com/app/keys. Keys are case-sensitive.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 via the Razorpay MCP server (mcp.razorpay.com). Supports Authorization Code with PKCE (S256) for user-delegated access and Client Credentials for server-to-server access. Tokens expire in 3600 seconds. Dynamic Client Registration available at the registration endpoint. For integration setup see https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/mcp-server/oauth.md.

scopes.read_only: Read-only access to Razorpay account data (payments, orders, refunds, payouts, subscriptions, invoices)
Read-only access to Razorpay account data (payments, orders, refunds, payouts, subscriptions, invoices)

from.name: from
from.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or after this time.

to.name: to
to.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or before this time.

count.name: count
count.description: Number of records to return per call. Maximum 100. Default 10.

skip.name: skip
skip.description: Number of records to skip. Use with count for pagination. Default 0.

Notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing custom metadata. Maximum 15 pairs. Each key and value must not exceed 256 characters.

code.description: Error code. Examples: BAD_REQUEST_ERROR, GATEWAY_ERROR, SERVER_ERROR.

source.description: Where the error originated (e.g. business, gateway).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason. Examples: insufficient_funds, invalid_expiry_date, declined_by_bank.

count.description: Number of items in the current page.

amount_paid.description: Total amount paid against this order (paise).

receipt.description: Your internal receipt or order reference number.

status.description: created: awaiting payment. attempted: payment attempted but not captured. paid: fully paid.

last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card number.

network.description: Card network. Examples: Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, Amex.

emi.description: Whether EMI is available on this card.

vpa.description: Customer UPI VPA (Virtual Payment Address). Example: user@upi.

flow.description: UPI flow used: collect, intent, or in_app.

status.description: created: initiated. authorized: bank approved, not yet captured. captured: funds collected. refunded: fully refunded. failed: transaction failed.

bank.description: Bank code for netbanking. Example: HDFC.

acquirer_data.description: Bank reference numbers for tracking: RRN (UPI/netbanking), ARN (cards), UTR (NEFT/RTGS).

batch_id.description: Set if refund was part of a batch upload.

status.description: pending: being processed. processed: credited to customer. failed: refund failed.

speed_requested.description: normal: 5-7 business days. optimum: instant if available, falls back to normal.

fees.description: Processing fees charged (typically 0 for normal settlements).

utr.description: Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number for bank tracking.

SettlementReconRecord.description: A single transaction line item in the settlement reconciliation report.

entity_id.description: ID of the transaction entity (payment, refund, etc.).

id.description: Unique instant settlement identifier. Prefix: setlod_

amount_settled.description: Total amount transferred minus fees and tax (paise).

amount_pending.description: Portion of requested amount yet to be settled (paise).

settle_full_balance.description: If true, settles maximum available balance.

description.description: Custom reference note. Max 30 alphanumeric characters.

ondemand_payouts.description: Collection of individual payout records for this instant settlement.

summary.description: Your explanation of why the dispute should be resolved in your favour. Max 1000 characters.

submitted_at.description: Unix timestamp of last evidence submission. Null for drafts.

payment_id.description: The payment against which the dispute was raised (pay_*).

amount_deducted.description: Amount deducted from your balance when dispute is lost.

reason_description.description: Human-readable explanation of the dispute cause.

respond_by.description: Unix timestamp by which you must respond. Missing this forfeits the dispute.

status.description: open: action required. under_review: evidence submitted, awaiting bank decision. won: resolved in your favour. lost: resolved against you. closed: resolved without chargeback.

phase.description: Escalation stage of the dispute process.

name.description: Customer name. 3-50 characters. Allowed: alphanumeric, period, apostrophe, forward slash, @, parentheses.

contact.description: Phone number. Max 15 characters. Include country code (e.g. +919876543210). Minimum 8 digits.

gstin.description: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (optional).

id.description: Unique document identifier. Example: doc_EsyWjHrfzb59Re. Always 14 alphanumeric characters.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

id.description: Unique payment link identifier. Prefix: plink_

amount.description: Payment amount in smallest currency unit (paise for INR). Three-decimal currencies (KWD, BHD, OMR): drop last decimal digit (e.g. 295.991 KWD → 295990). Zero-decimal currencies (JPY): pass value as-is.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. UPI Payment Links only support INR.

accept_partial.description: Allow partial payments. Not supported for UPI links.

first_min_partial_amount.description: Minimum amount required for the first partial payment.

reference_id.description: Your unique tracking reference. Max 40 characters. Must be unique per link.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp when link expires. Default: 6 months from creation. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

expired_at.description: Unix timestamp when link actually expired.

cancelled_at.description: Unix timestamp when link was cancelled.

status.description: created: awaiting payment. partially_paid: one or more partial payments received. expired: past expiry with no full payment. cancelled: manually cancelled. paid: fully paid.

upi_link.description: true if this is a UPI Payment Link, false for standard.

short_url.description: Shareable short URL for the payment link.

customer.description: Customer contact details. These are not auto-populated on the checkout page — customer must enter them manually.

sms.description: true: Razorpay sends SMS notification. false: merchant handles.

email.description: true: Razorpay sends email notification. false: merchant handles.

payments.description: Captured payment records. Populated only after successful payment capture.

user_id.description: Identifier for the user role that created the link.

id.description: Unique QR code identifier. Prefix: qr_

image_url.description: Hosted URL of the QR code image.

payment_amount.description: Fixed payment amount in paise. Null for variable-amount QR codes.

close_by.description: Unix timestamp when the QR code will auto-close.

closed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the QR code was closed.

close_reason.description: Why the QR code was closed.

payments_amount_received.description: Total amount received via this QR code (paise).

Item.description: A reusable catalog item used in invoice line items.

active.description: Whether the item is active and available for use in new invoices.

amount.description: Item price in paise (smallest INR unit).

item_id.description: Referenced catalog item ID (item_*). Null for ad-hoc line items.

amount.description: Total line amount in paise (unit_amount × quantity).

Invoice.description: An invoice or payment page sent to a customer for payment. Cannot be used to create GST invoices (those must be created via the Dashboard).

type.description: invoice: a formal invoice document. link: a payment page / payment link.

customer.description: Inline customer details snapshot at time of invoice creation.

payment_id.description: Payment ID (pay_*) of the successful payment, if paid.

gross_amount.description: Sum of all line item amounts before tax (paise).

amount_paid.description: Amount received so far (paise). Relevant for partial_payment invoices.

short_url.description: Hosted payment page URL to send to the customer.

partial_payment.description: If true, customer can pay any amount ≥ first_payment_min_amount.

first_payment_min_amount.description: Minimum amount for the first partial payment (paise). Required when partial_payment=true.

terms.description: Payment terms shown on the invoice.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the invoice expires and cannot be paid.

Plan.description: A billing plan defining the recurring charge amount and frequency. Reusable across multiple subscriptions.

interval.description: Number of periods between charges. For daily period, minimum interval is 7.

period.description: Billing frequency unit. daily requires interval ≥ 7.

item.description: The item (price, currency, name) billed each cycle.

Subscription.description: A recurring billing subscription linking a customer to a plan. Requires customer mandate authorization via short_url before charges can be collected.

status.description: Subscription lifecycle status. created→authenticated (mandate authorized)→active→completed/cancelled/expired. pending=charge retry scheduled; halted=multiple failures; paused=temporarily stopped.

current_start.description: Unix timestamp of current billing cycle start.

current_end.description: Unix timestamp of current billing cycle end.

quantity.description: Number of plan units billed per cycle.

charge_at.description: Unix timestamp of next scheduled charge attempt.

start_at.description: Unix timestamp of first charge. Defaults to subscription creation time.

end_at.description: Unix timestamp after which no more charges will be attempted.

paid_count.description: Number of billing cycles successfully charged.

customer_notify.description: 1 = Razorpay sends SMS/email notifications to customer on each charge.

short_url.description: Mandate authorization URL. Must be sent to the customer to activate the subscription.

has_scheduled_changes.description: True if a plan/quantity change is scheduled for the next cycle.

source.description: Source that created the subscription (e.g., api, dashboard).

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp by which the customer must authorize the mandate.

LinkedAccount.description: A sub-merchant (Linked Account) created under a Route marketplace account. Linked Accounts can receive transfers and settlements. Prefix: acc_

type.description: Account type. Always 'route' for Route marketplace accounts.

email.description: Contact email. Cannot be updated after creation.

phone.description: Contact phone number with country code (e.g., +919876543210).

legal_business_name.description: Registered legal name of the business.

business_type.description: Business type. Cannot be updated after creation.

contact_name.description: Name of the primary contact person.

Stakeholder.description: A business owner or director associated with a Linked Account. Only one stakeholder is allowed per Route Linked Account. Prefix: sth_

director.description: True if the stakeholder is a company director.

executive.description: True if the stakeholder is an executive.

ProductConfiguration.description: Route product configuration for a Linked Account. Controls settlement account details and tracks activation status. Prefix: acc_prd_

account_id.description: Linked Account ID this configuration belongs to.

product_name.description: Product name. Always 'route' for Route product.

activation_status.description: Current activation status. Progresses from requested → under_review → activated. needs_clarification requires additional info from the merchant.

accepted_at.description: Unix timestamp when TnC was accepted.

requested_configuration.description: Configuration details provided during activation request.

ifsc_code.description: IFSC code of the settlement bank.

requirements.description: List of pending requirements needed for activation.

requested_at.description: Unix timestamp when product was requested.

Transfer.description: A fund transfer from a merchant or captured payment to a Linked Account (Route). Minimum amount is ₹100 (10000 paise). INR only. Prefix: trf_

source.description: Source entity ID (payment ID, order ID, or merchant account ID for direct transfers).

amount_reversed.description: Total amount reversed so far in paise.

tax.description: GST on transfer fee in paise.

settlement_status.description: Settlement status of the transferred funds in the Linked Account.

on_hold.description: If true, settlement of this transfer is on hold.

on_hold_until.description: Unix timestamp until which settlement is on hold. null means indefinite hold.

recipient_settlement_id.description: Settlement ID (setl_*) in the Linked Account once settled.

linked_account_notes.description: Keys from notes that will be visible to the Linked Account in their dashboard.

processed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the transfer was processed.

Reversal.description: A reversal of a transfer — moves funds back from the Linked Account to the merchant. Partial reversals are supported and multiple reversals per transfer are allowed. Prefix: rvrsl_

initiator_id.description: ID of the entity that initiated the reversal.

VirtualAccount.description: A virtual bank account or VPA that accepts NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI payments (Smart Collect). Each payment creates a BankTransfer entity. Auto-closes after 90 days of inactivity. Prefix: va_

name.description: Display name of the virtual account.

description.description: Purpose or description of the virtual account.

amount_expected.description: Expected payment amount in paise. 0 means any amount is accepted.

amount_paid.description: Total amount received so far in paise.

status.description: active = accepting payments; closed = no longer accepting payments.

receivers.description: Payment receivers assigned to this virtual account. Can include bank_account (ba_*) and/or vpa (vpa_*) receivers.

id.description: Receiver ID. Prefix: ba_ for bank account, vpa_ for VPA.

name.description: Account holder name (bank accounts) or VPA address (VPAs).

username.description: UPI username part of the VPA (VPAs only).

close_by.description: Unix timestamp by which the account will auto-close. Maximum value: 2147483647.

closed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the account was closed.

customer_id.description: Customer ID linked to this virtual account (cust_*).

BankTransfer.description: A payment received into a Virtual Account via bank transfer (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI). Created automatically when a payer sends funds to the virtual account. Prefix: bt_

payment_id.description: Razorpay payment ID generated for this bank transfer (pay_*).

mode.description: Transfer mode used by the payer.

bank_reference.description: UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) number from the bank.

virtual_account_id.description: Virtual account that received this transfer (va_*).

Bill.description: A Razorpay Billme digital receipt/bill. Used for retail, food & beverage, events, ecommerce, and other use cases.

event.description: Event details for events business type

irn.description: Invoice Reference Number for GST e-invoicing

PartnerAccount.description: A sub-merchant account created by a Partner (Aggregator/Platform) via the Partners API. Uses OAuth access_token authentication. Type=standard for Partners vs type=route for Route API.

reference_id.description: Partner's internal reference for this merchant

PartnerProductConfiguration.description: Product configuration for a sub-merchant account. Partners configure payment_gateway or payment_links; Route API uses 'route'. One payment method can be updated per PATCH request.

id.description: Product config ID with prefix acc_prd_

payment_methods.description: One payment method can be updated per PATCH request

PartnerStakeholder.description: A stakeholder (director/executive) associated with a sub-merchant account. Multiple stakeholders allowed per account (unlike Route which allows only 1).

PartnerWebhook.description: A webhook configured for a sub-merchant account via the Partners API. Maximum 30 webhooks per account.

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events

events.description: Map of event names to boolean

AccountDocument.description: KYC documents for a sub-merchant account. Files must be JPG/PNG (max 4MB) or PDF (max 2MB).

StakeholderDocument.description: KYC documents for a stakeholder. Supports PAN, Aadhaar, passport, and voter ID. Files must be JPG/PNG (max 4MB) or PDF (max 2MB).

XContact.description: RazorpayX payout recipient. Created before sending payouts.

type.description: Built-in types only via API; custom types must be created on Dashboard first

reference_id.description: External reference (must be unique per merchant)

FundAccount.description: Payout destination linked to a Contact. Immutable after creation.

wallet.description: Amazon Pay wallet details. Required when account_type=wallet.

name.description: Wallet holder name. Case-sensitive. Supported: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, space, ', -, _, /, (, ), .

Payout.description: RazorpayX payout disbursement. Idempotency header X-Payout-Idempotency required since March 15, 2025.

mode.description: Transfer mode — case-sensitive. amazonpay limited to ₹10,000 per transaction; no custom narration allowed.

queue_if_low_balance.description: true: queue payout when account balance is insufficient. false (default): fail immediately.

FundAccountValidation.description: Bank/VPA account validation result. Live-mode only, RazorpayX Lite only.

upi_intent.description: Present only for reverse penny drop (UPI intent flow)

PayoutLink.description: Payout link sent to a contact when fund account details are unavailable.

expire_by.description: Must be at least 15 minutes in the future

XTransaction.description: RazorpayX transaction record — inflow (bank_transfer credit) or outflow (payout debit).

amount.description: Amount in paise (does not include fees/tax)

credit.description: Amount credited in paise; 0 for debits

debit.description: Amount debited in paise; 0 for credits

balance.description: Remaining account balance in paise after this transaction

source.description: Source entity — either a payout (debit) or bank_transfer (credit)

id.description: pout_* for payouts, bt_* for bank transfers

fees.description: Payout only, populated at processing state

tax.description: Payout only, populated at processing state

401.description: Authentication failed. Invalid or missing API key credentials.

400.description: Bad request. Invalid parameters or missing required fields.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Implement exponential backoff with jitter before retrying.

post.description: Create an order before initiating a payment. The returned order_id must be passed to Razorpay Checkout. An order can have multiple payment attempts but only one successful capture.

amount.description: Payment amount in paise. Example: 50000 for ₹500. Must be >= 100.

receipt.description: Your internal receipt number. Max 40 characters.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of orders. Maximum 100 records per call.

parameters.name: authorized
parameters.description: 1 = orders with authorized payments only. 0 = without.

get.description: Retrieve the full details and current status of a specific order.

patch.description: Update the notes field of an existing order. Only notes can be modified after creation.

get.description: Retrieve all authorized and failed payment attempts made against a specific order.

200.description: Collection of payments for the order.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of payments. Maximum 100 per call.
Retrieve full details and current status of a specific payment. Always re-fetch before acting — status can change.

patch.description: Update the notes field of a payment. Only notes can be modified.

post.description: Capture an authorized payment to collect funds. Must be called within the capture window (default 5 days). Amount must exactly equal authorized amount unless partial capture is enabled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment ID (pay_*). Must be in 'authorized' status.

amount.description: Amount to capture in paise. Must equal authorized amount unless partial capture is enabled.

post.description: Initiate a full or partial refund for a captured payment. Use speed=normal (default, 5-7 business days) or speed=optimum for instant refund (falls back to normal if unavailable). Use the X-Refund-Idempotency header with a unique key (>=10 chars) to safely retry without duplicate refunds.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment ID to refund (pay_*). Payment must be captured.

amount.description: Refund amount in paise. Omit to refund the full payment amount.

speed.description: normal: 5-7 business days. optimum: instant if available, falls back to normal.

x-idempotency.description: Unique key (>=10 chars, alphanumeric/hyphens/underscores). Same key + same payload = same result. Different payload = BAD_REQUEST. 409 Conflict = prior request still processing, retry.

get.description: Retrieve all refunds issued against a specific payment.

200.description: Collection of refunds for the payment.

get.summary: Fetch a specific refund for a payment
get.description: Retrieve a specific refund by its ID scoped to a particular payment.
Retrieve a paginated list of all refunds across payments. Maximum 100 per call.
Retrieve full details and current status of a specific refund.

patch.description: Update the notes field of a refund. Only notes can be modified.

get.description: Retrieve current and upcoming payment method downtimes for cards, netbanking, and UPI. Use to surface degraded methods in checkout UI.

200.description: Collection of active and scheduled downtimes.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific payment downtime event.
Retrieve a paginated list of settlements. Each settlement represents a batch transfer to your bank account. Maximum 100 per call.
Retrieve details of a specific settlement transaction.

Retrieve a detailed transaction-level reconciliation report for a given month (or day). Each record maps a payment, refund, transfer, or adjustment to its settlement. Use for accounting reconciliation. Maximum 1000 records per call.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Settlement day in DD format (1–31). Omit to fetch the full month.

post.description: Request an on-demand (instant) settlement of your available Razorpay balance to your bank account. Fees apply. Use settle_full_balance=true to settle everything available, or specify an amount.

settle_full_balance.description: Set true to settle the full available balance. Overrides amount.

description.description: Custom reference note. Max 30 alphanumeric characters.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all on-demand instant settlements. Use expand[]=ondemand_payouts to include individual payout records inline.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Set to ondemand_payouts to include payout details.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific on-demand instant settlement. Use expand[]=ondemand_payouts to include payout records.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Set to ondemand_payouts to include payout details.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all payment disputes. Use expand[]=payment or expand[]=transaction.settlement for additional context.
Retrieve full details of a specific dispute including submitted evidence.

post.description: Accept a dispute, acknowledging it as lost. This is irreversible — the dispute status changes to 'lost' and the disputed amount is deducted from your balance. Only accept if you do not wish to contest.

patch.description: Submit evidence to challenge a dispute. Use action=draft to save without submitting, or action=submit to send for bank review (triggers payment.dispute.under_review webhook). At least one evidence document is required when submitting. You can contest partial amounts by specifying amount.

action.description: draft: save evidence without submitting. submit: send for bank review. Minimum one document required for submit.

amount.description: Amount being contested (paise). Defaults to full dispute amount.

summary.description: Your explanation of why the dispute should be resolved in your favour. Max 1000 characters.

200.description: Dispute contested. Status changes to 'under_review' on submit.

post.description: Create a customer profile. The combination of email and contact must be unique per customer. Customer profiles enable saved card tokens, faster checkout, and customer-scoped data.

name.description: Customer name. 3-50 characters. Allowed: alphanumeric, period, apostrophe, forward slash, @, parentheses.

contact.description: Phone number with country code. Min 8 digits, max 15 chars. Example: +919876543210.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all customers. Maximum 100 per call.
Retrieve full details of a specific customer.

put.description: Update a customer's name, email, or contact. The combination of email and contact must remain unique. Contact number must contain at least 8 digits.

contact.description: Updated phone number. Min 8 digits including country code.

post.description: Upload a file to Razorpay. Returns a document ID that can be used in dispute evidence submissions. Supports JPEG, PNG, and PDF formats.

file.description: File to upload. Supported: JPEG, PNG, PDF.

get.description: Retrieve metadata for an uploaded document (name, MIME type, size, purpose). Document IDs are exactly 14 alphanumeric characters.

post.description: Retrieve the binary content of a previously uploaded document. Returns the raw file bytes.

Create a shareable payment link to collect payments via SMS and email. Supports standard links (all payment methods) and UPI-only links (set upi_link=true). UPI links are not available in test mode. Partial payments are not supported for UPI links. Links expire after 6 months by default.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (paise for INR). Example: 50000 for ₹500.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. UPI links support INR only.

upi_link.description: Set true to create a UPI-only Payment Link. Not available in test mode.

accept_partial.description: Enable partial payments. Not supported for UPI links.

first_min_partial_amount.description: Minimum first partial payment amount in paise.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp for link expiry. Max 6 months from creation. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

reference_id.description: Your unique tracking reference. Max 40 characters. Must be unique.

description.description: Brief description shown on the payment page. Max 2048 characters.

customer.description: Customer contact details. Not auto-populated on checkout — customer must enter manually.

notify.description: Notification handlers. Set true for Razorpay to send, false to handle yourself.

name.description: Custom business name displayed on checkout.

hide_topbar.description: Hide the checkout top bar to prevent method switching.

method.description: Enable or disable specific payment methods.

config.description: Advanced checkout display configuration (blocks, sequence, preferences).

blocks.description: Custom payment method groupings with names and instruments.

sequence.description: Display order of payment method blocks.

hosted_page.description: Customise labels on the payment details section of the hosted page.

label.description: Map of field names to custom label text. Supports localisation (Hindi, Tamil, etc.).

order.description: Order-level options including offers and transfers.

offers.description: Offer IDs to apply. Do not combine with accept_partial.

get.description: Retrieve all payment links. Filter by payment_id or reference_id to narrow results.

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: Filter by your custom reference number.

get.description: Retrieve full details of a specific payment link.

patch.description: Update an existing payment link. Updates are only allowed when the link is in 'created' or 'partially_paid' status.

reference_id.description: Add or update unique reference number. Max 40 characters.

post.description: Cancel a payment link. Only links in 'created' status can be cancelled. Paid, partially paid, and already expired links cannot be cancelled.

200.description: Payment link cancelled. Status changes to 'cancelled'.

post.summary: Send or resend payment link notification
post.description: Send or resend a payment link notification to the customer via SMS or email.

Create a UPI QR code for accepting digital payments. Only upi_qr type is supported (on-demand feature; requires merchant activation). single_use QR codes require fixed_amount=true and close_by maximum is 45 days. multiple_use QR codes have no expiry restriction.

type.description: QR code type. Only upi_qr is supported (on-demand feature requiring merchant activation).

usage.description: single_use: auto-closes after first successful payment (requires fixed_amount=true). multiple_use: stays open for multiple payments.

fixed_amount.description: true: fixed amount QR (required for single_use). false: customer enters amount at scan time.

payment_amount.description: Fixed payment amount in paise. Required when fixed_amount=true.

customer_id.description: Associate QR code with a customer (cust_*).

close_by.description: Unix timestamp for auto-close. Maximum 45 days from creation for single_use.

get.description: Retrieve all QR codes. Filter by customer_id or payment_id.

parameters.name: payment_id
parameters.description: Filter QR codes associated with a specific payment.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific QR code including payment counts and status.

patch.description: Update the notes field of a QR code. Only notes can be modified after creation.

post.description: Deactivate a QR code to stop accepting new payments. Once closed, the QR code cannot be reopened.

200.description: QR code closed. Status changes to 'closed'.

get.summary: Fetch payments for a QR code
get.description: Retrieve all payments made against a specific QR code.

200.description: Collection of payments for the QR code.

post.description: Create a reusable catalog item. Items can be referenced in invoice line_items by item_id, which auto-fills price and description. Each item is merchant-scoped.

get.description: Retrieve all catalog items. Supports pagination.
Get details of a specific catalog item.

patch.description: Update the name, description, amount, currency, or active status of an item.

delete.description: Permanently delete a catalog item. Deleted items cannot be recovered.

post.description: Create an invoice or payment page. Set type='invoice' for a formal invoice or type='link' for a simple payment page. The invoice is created in draft state; call POST /invoices/{id}/issue to send it to the customer. Cannot be used to create GST invoices (use the Dashboard for those). Maximum 50 line items per invoice.

type.description: invoice: formal invoice; link: payment page.

customer_id.description: Existing customer ID (cust_*). Provide this OR customer object, not both.

customer.description: Inline customer details. Used when no customer_id is available.

line_items.description: Invoice line items. Each item must have name and amount (in paise), or an item_id to reference a catalog item.

item_id.description: Reference a catalog item. Populates name, amount, currency automatically.

terms.description: Payment terms shown on the invoice.

partial_payment.description: Allow customer to pay a partial amount initially.

first_payment_min_amount.description: Minimum first payment amount in paise. Required when partial_payment=true.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the invoice expires. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

get.description: Retrieve a list of invoices. Filter by type, status, customer, payment, or subscription. Returns up to 100 per call.

parameters.name: payment_id
parameters.description: Filter invoices by the payment ID used to pay them.

parameters.name: subscription_id

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Orders are the starting point for accepting a payment. Create an order with the amount and currency, pass the order_id to Razorpay Checkout, then verify the payment signature after success.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: A payment is created when a customer completes checkout. Payments can be auto-captured or manually captured. Fetch payment details to reconcile and diagnose failures.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Refunds return captured payment amounts to customers. Normal refunds take 5-7 business days. Instant (optimum) refunds settle immediately but may fall back to normal. Use X-Refund-Idempotency header to safely retry without duplicates.

tags.name: Payment Downtimes
tags.description: Scheduled and live downtime information for card, netbanking, and UPI. Poll or subscribe to payment.downtime webhooks to detect degraded methods and adjust your checkout UI.

tags.name: Payment Links
tags.description: Payment Links are shareable URLs to collect payments without a website. Share via SMS, email, or any channel. Supports partial payments, expiry, reminders, UPI-only mode, offers, and transfers to linked accounts.

tags.name: QR Codes
tags.description: QR Codes enable offline and digital payment collection. Customers scan with any UPI or card app. Supports fixed-amount and variable-amount codes, single-use and multiple-use modes.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customer profiles store contact information for recurring billing, saved cards, and personalised checkout. Each email+contact combination must be unique.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Document uploads for dispute evidence. Upload JPEG, PNG, or PDF files and receive a document ID to reference in dispute contest submissions.

tags.name: Settlements
tags.description: Settlements represent batch transfers of collected payment funds to your bank account. Use the recon endpoint for transaction-level reconciliation reports mapping each payment, refund, and adjustment to its settlement.

tags.name: Instant Settlements
tags.description: On-demand settlements let you transfer your available Razorpay balance to your bank account immediately, outside the normal settlement cycle. Fees apply. Requires Instant Settlements to be enabled on your account.

tags.name: Disputes
tags.description: Disputes (chargebacks) are raised by customers via their bank. You can accept (lose) or contest (challenge with evidence) each dispute. Monitor respond_by timestamp — missing the deadline forfeits the dispute.

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Reusable catalog items that can be referenced in invoice line items. Defining items once avoids repeating price and description on each invoice.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Invoices and payment pages for one-time or partial-payment collection. Create in draft, issue to the customer, and track payment status. Cannot be used for GST invoices (use the Dashboard for those). Maximum 50 line items per invoice.

tags.name: Plans
tags.description: Billing plan definitions for recurring subscriptions. A plan sets the billing period, interval, and per-cycle charge. Plans are reusable across multiple subscriptions and cannot be modified after creation.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Recurring billing subscriptions. Customers must authorize a payment mandate (UPI Autopay, NACH, or card-on-file) via the short_url before charges begin. Supports pause/resume, plan changes, add-ons, and indefinite billing cycles.

tags.name: Linked Accounts
tags.description: Sub-merchant accounts (Linked Accounts) created under a Route marketplace. Includes account creation, stakeholder KYC, and Route product activation. Uses /v2/ API base path. Only one stakeholder is allowed per Linked Account. email and business_type cannot be changed after creation.

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description: Fund transfers from a merchant, payment, or order to a Linked Account (Route). Supports payment-based splits, direct on-demand transfers, settlement hold controls, and full/partial reversals. INR only, minimum ₹100. Direct transfers support idempotency via X-Transfer-Idempotency header.

tags.name: Virtual Accounts
tags.description: Virtual bank accounts and UPI VPAs that accept NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI payments (Smart Collect). Each incoming payment creates a BankTransfer entity. Supports Third Party Validation (TPV) to restrict payers, and VPA receivers (Smart Collect 2.0). Auto-closes after 90 days of inactivity.

tags.name: Bills
tags.description: Razorpay Billme digital receipts and bills for retail, food & beverage, events, and ecommerce.

tags.name: Partner Accounts
tags.description: Sub-merchant account lifecycle management via Partners API (Aggregator/Platform model). Uses OAuth access_token authentication.

tags.name: Partner Products
tags.description: Configure payment_gateway or payment_links products for sub-merchant accounts.

tags.name: Partner Stakeholders
tags.description: Manage stakeholders (directors/executives) for sub-merchant accounts. Multiple stakeholders allowed per account.

tags.name: Partner Documents
tags.description: Upload and fetch KYC documents for sub-merchant accounts and their stakeholders.

tags.name: Partner Webhooks
tags.description: Configure webhooks for sub-merchant accounts to receive payment events. Maximum 30 per account.

tags.name: X Contacts
tags.description: RazorpayX payout recipients — create, fetch, update contacts

tags.name: X Fund Accounts
tags.description: Payout destination accounts (bank, VPA, card) linked to contacts

tags.name: X Account Validation
tags.description: Penny drop and reverse penny drop bank/VPA validation

tags.name: X Payouts
tags.description: Disbursements via NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, card — includes composite and approval flows

tags.name: X Banking Balances
tags.description: Fetch RazorpayX account balances

tags.name: X Payout Links
tags.description: Payout links for recipients without saved fund accounts

tags.name: X Transactions
tags.description: Fetch RazorpayX transaction records — credits (bank_transfer inflows) and debits (payout outflows)

x-rateLimit.description: Razorpay does not publish specific rate limits. If you receive HTTP 429, implement exponential backoff with jitter and retry. Add randomisation to avoid thundering-herd effects.

x-pagination.description: All list endpoints return at most 100 records per call (1000 for settlement recon). Use count and skip together to paginate. Date range filters (from/to) use Unix timestamps in seconds.

x-amountEncoding.description: All monetary amounts are in the smallest currency sub-unit. For INR: 1 rupee = 100 paise, so ₹500 = 50000. Minimum for INR is 100 paise (₹1). Three-decimal currencies (KWD, BHD, OMR): drop last decimal digit. Zero-decimal currencies (JPY): pass value as-is.
